panels.title: Crew wake one by one and gather
beats: Approved v4; its last frame (shown) is the reference for every shot below.
End: Antony nearest the bow pointing out with his right arm; Raghavan just aft of him, then Babu, then Sasi; Aashaan at the wheel inside.

panels.title: Continuity check (L118, L119)
beats: Previous frames: s23-sh01 and sh02 (fire a tiny far light, left horizon), s23-sh05 (men at the left rail).
Fire never closer than the horizon (~500 m) until a shot shows the uru closing in.
Antony nearest the bow; Raghavan, Babu, Sasi aft; Aashaan at the wheel.
Raghavan and Babu attached and placed, so no invented men; no lantern on the rail.
panels.refs: planning only; the frame itself goes in the reference slot of s23-sh06

panels.title: Antony: "Bring a rope!" (over Raghavan's shoulder)
beats: 3D camera view at real distances: Raghavan's back soft at left, Babu's head far left, Antony sharp at centre-right.
The fire stays a tiny point on the horizon ~500 m off, right of centre (as in s23-sh01/02/05).
3.0–4.2 s "Bring a rope!"; 4.2–8 s silent, nobody moves, he grips the rail. Push-in 2.0 to 1.5 m.
Exactly three men; only Antony's face. Voice: Mahendran J.

panels.title: Raghavan: "Don't go."
beats: 3D camera view: from beside Antony's head looking AFT at Raghavan; deckhouse glow behind, rail at the right.
Eyes on Antony just RIGHT of the lens from frame one; his hand takes Antony's wrist at the lower right edge.
3–4 s "Don't go."; 4–8 s silent, the wrist pulls free, empty hand. Voice: Nguyen Tue.

panels.title: Insert: Antony frees his wrist
beats: CU: Raghavan's old hand holding Antony's RIGHT wrist tightly on the rail top.
2.5–5 s Antony twists free; 5–8 s the old hand left open, then grips the rail.
